decisions.statement: The watch sits behind the guard on being the file run.
Loading this file declares its value and starts nothing.
The mailbox is opened once and every pass reads through that one opening.
A pass that throws is said and the watch goes on to the next pass.
A run that threw says what that run had already carried out before it threw.
Each run is handed a list of its own rather than one the watch keeps filling.
A pass that acted on nothing and found nothing waiting or unclaimed or discarded says nothing.
Only claims nobody has been told about yet are announced.
A claim is marked told only once the telling has landed.
A claim is told to the persona whose channel it names rather than to the handler.
A claim carrying no handle is told to the handler.
A telling that fails leaves only that handle's claims untold.
An untold claim is tried again on the next pass.
A claim an agent rule took is put to the handler as the handler's to judge.
A claim a rule asked the handler be told of is put to the handler as news.
The mail announced is still in the inbox.
A stop asked for during the wait ends the wait rather than the wait running out.
The checkout the watch reads is worked out as the file loads rather than as the run starts.

definition: alan's mail decided over and over, and each agent told the claims waiting on that agent
